newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT-UK equities cut at JP Morgan.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-UK equities cut at JP Morgan.

text.p: JP Morgan cut its long-term rating on UK equities to "underweight" from "neutral," strategists Gary Dugan and Caroline Meroz said in a research note.
They said the UK was the only corporate sector in Europe facing problems of a substantially appreciating currency, rising interest rates and falling corporate profit forecasts.
The JP Morgan strategists said their "fair value" target of 4,900 for the FTSE 100 index at year end offered little upside from current levels.
